# Do not cache class getter values by assigning to a getter-only property

The May module conversion kept legacy Spotlight getters that deleted and then assigned to this._profileDir and this._metadataDir. On class instances, the inherited getter-only property made that assignment throw, so a later patch initialized #profileDir and #metadataDir private fields in the constructor. The D226115 review explicitly said that this removed the console error but did not restore Spotlight search. Existing messages also needed backfill because indexing happens as messages arrive. Treat the getter fix and a working Spotlight index as separate outcomes.

Scope: Spotlight search.

Paths:

- `mail/components/search/SpotlightIntegration.sys.mjs`
